annotations.title: Roof plan as a PDF (solar roof check)

description: The plan behind a solar roof check link as the one-page PDF report the solar roof check page prints, in German, for the person to keep or print: the 3D picture, key figures, the roof from above with its modules, the faces, kWh month by month, self-use with and without battery, the worst shade casters, and a QR code that opens the plan. The PDF comes back inside this answer as an embedded resource (application/pdf, base64); save it as a file. Nothing is stored on the server and no download link is made. This one-shot call waits at most 55 seconds for the page's own report and otherwise answers with a drawn version (same modules; the answer's page_report says why and where the time went); for the page's own report with more time use roof_report_pdf_start. An example, not a quote; the price guide in it is a rough guide, never an offer. With without_price: true the report leaves out the price guide and anything worked out from a price, the QR code and the line to the solar roof check page (which shows the guide) and the sentence promising a visit on site (for an installer's own estimate the report is appended to, so the document carries one price only); that one is always the drawn version. price_shown in the answer says what the file holds: false only when it shows no price of Sky Solar's.

link.description: A solar roof check link (https://pv.skysolar.de/dachcheck/#d=…), as plan_roof, edit_roof or the solar roof check page gave it.

without_price.description: true: the report without Sky Solar's price guide and anything worked out from a price (for appending to an installer's own estimate, so the document carries one price only), and without the QR code and the line that lead to the solar roof check page (which shows the price guide) and without the sentence promising a visit on site; it is then always the drawn version, as the page's own report shows the guide. Default false: the report as the solar roof check page prints it. price_shown in the answer says what the file holds.
